name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
summary: Rules differ by entity: in the Federation (FBiH) unauthorised possession of any drug is a crime (up to 1 yr); Republika Srpska and Brčko criminal codes only cover possession for sale. Supply: 1–10 yrs.
poisonControlNote: No poison information centre is listed in WHO's 2023 directory; call 124 (ambulance).
callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan law or other specific legal protection for people who call for help in an overdose was found.

fbih.title: Criminal Code of the Federation of BiH, arts. 238–239 (consolidated to Sl. novine 58/2025)

rs.title: Criminal Code of Republika Srpska, arts. 207–208 (to Sl. glasnik 73/2023)

bd.title: Criminal Code of Brčko District, arts. 232–233 (to Sl. glasnik 14/2024)

incb.title: INCB Green List 2026 – psychotropic substances under international control

who.title: WHO – World directory of poisons centres (2023)

lsd.note: UN Schedule I. FBiH: possession is a crime (up to 1 yr, CC art. 239). Republika Srpska/Brčko: criminal only if held for sale.

mushrooms.note: Psilocybin is UN Schedule I; mushrooms presumably treated likewise. FBiH: possession up to 1 yr.

dmt.note: UN Schedule I. FBiH: possession is a crime (up to 1 yr, CC art. 239). Republika Srpska/Brčko: criminal only if held for sale.

mescaline.note: UN Schedule I; cacti status not confirmed. FBiH: possession is a crime (up to 1 yr, CC art. 239). Republika Srpska/Brčko: criminal only if held for sale.

dox.note: DOM, DOB, DOC: UN Schedule I. FBiH: possession is a crime (up to 1 yr, CC art. 239). Republika Srpska/Brčko: criminal only if held for sale.

nbomes.note: UN Schedule I since 2015. FBiH: possession is a crime (up to 1 yr, CC art. 239). Republika Srpska/Brčko: criminal only if held for sale.

2c-x.note: 2C-B is UN Schedule II. FBiH: possession is a crime (up to 1 yr, CC art. 239). Republika Srpska/Brčko: criminal only if held for sale.

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T compounds are not UN-controlled; national scheduling not confirmed.

5-meo-xxt.note: 5-MeO tryptamines are not UN-controlled; national scheduling not confirmed.

cannabis.note: FBiH: possession is a crime (up to 1 yr, CC art. 239). Republika Srpska/Brčko: criminal only if held for sale. In RS, growing counts as production (1–10 yrs).

ketamine.note: Anaesthetic used in hospitals and veterinary practice; not UN-controlled and national control status not confirmed.

mxe.note: UN Schedule II since 2016. FBiH: possession is a crime (up to 1 yr, CC art. 239). Republika Srpska/Brčko: criminal only if held for sale.

dxm.note: Not UN-controlled; national control and prescription status not confirmed.

nitrous.note: Not internationally controlled; no national restriction confirmed.

amphetamines.note: UN Schedule II. FBiH: possession is a crime (up to 1 yr, CC art. 239). Republika Srpska/Brčko: criminal only if held for sale.

mdma.note: UN Schedule I. FBiH: possession is a crime (up to 1 yr, CC art. 239). Republika Srpska/Brčko: criminal only if held for sale.

cocaine.note: 1961 Convention drug. FBiH: possession is a crime (up to 1 yr, CC art. 239). Republika Srpska/Brčko: criminal only if held for sale.

alcohol.note: Selling alcohol to under-18s is an offence.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is UN Schedule II (FBiH: possession up to 1 yr). GBL/1,4-BD status not confirmed.

opioids.note: Heroin etc. are controlled. FBiH: possession is a crime (up to 1 yr, CC art. 239). Republika Srpska/Brčko: criminal only if held for sale.

tramadol.note: Prescription-only painkiller; not UN-controlled and national control status not confirmed.

maois.note: MAOI antidepressants are prescription-only; harmala/Syrian rue status not confirmed; ayahuasca contains DMT (controlled).
